items.title: ASX rallies as tech and mining giants shine
items.summary: Despite a hotter-than-expected inflation reading, the ASX 200 has surged 0.80 per cent as global markets and soaring commodity prices overwhelmed concerns about rate hikes.

items.title: WiseTech shares jump 16.7% to nearly 10-month high as FY27 outlook holds
items.summary: Investing.com -- WiseTech Global shares surged to a nearly 10-month high on Friday after the logistics software provider expressed confidence in achieving its annual revenue forecast, with stronger CargoWise trading and lower operating costs supporting its outlook.

aus.headline: ASX Climbs As Miners Shine
aus.body: The ASX 200 rose 0.80% as global markets and strong commodity prices lifted shares.
aus.why: A hot inflation reading failed to stop local shares climbing.

us.headline: S&P 500 Has Best Week Of Year
us.body: The S&P 500 gained 5.6% this week, with materials and tech stocks out in front.
us.why: Big moves on Wall Street often shape how the ASX trades.

biz.headline: WiseTech Jumps To 10-Month High
biz.body: WiseTech Global shares rose 16.7% after it backed its annual revenue target.
biz.why: A major local tech name is back near its best level in ten months.
